GUILBERT T. SUAREZ Secretary to the Sanggunian Sangguniang Panlalawigan of Catanduanes Legislative Building, Capitol Compound Virac, Catanduanes Dear Atty. Suarez: This has reference to your letter dated 28 July 2020, forwarding to this Department Resolution No. 416-2-20 passed by the Sangguniang Panialawigan of Catanduanes, re: "RESOLUTION EARNESTLY REQUESTING THE SECRETARY OF THE DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT (DILG), FOR THE ISSUANCE OF GUIDELINES PROVIDING IMMEDIATE REMEDY IN FILLING UP VACANT POSITIONS OF SANGGUNIANG KABATAAN OFFICIALS IN THE PROVINCE OF CA TANDUANES". Per the Resolution passed by the SP of Catanduanes, due to the resignation of either SK Chairperson or SK Members, most of the barangays in the Province of Catanduanes are without functional SK as the said barangay SK Councils cannot convene as it is unable to muster a quorum. Hence, they requested the SILG to issue guidelines providing for immediate remedy in filling up vacant positions of SK officials in the Province of Catanduanes. Foremost, there arises permanent vacancy due to the resignation of SK officials, hence, Section 19 of the Implementing Rules and Regulations ORR) of Republic Act No. 10742, otherwise known as the "Sangguniang Kabataan Reform Act of 2015" applies, which states that: "SECTION 19. Succession and Filling up of Vacancies. - (a) In case an SK chairperson refuses to assume office, fails to qualify, voluntarily resigns, dies, is permanently incapacitated, is removed from office, the SK member who obtained the highest number of votes in the election immediately preceding shall assume the office of the chairperson for the unexpired portion of his or her term. In case said member refuses to assume the position or fails to qualify, the SK member obtaining the next

highest number of votes shall assume the position of the chairperson for the unexpired portion of the term. (b) After the vacancy shall have been filled, the SK chairperson shall, within thirty (30) days, call for a special SK assembly to elect an SK member to complete the membership of said sanggunian. Provided, that, such special assembly is coordinated with the Office of the LGOO and the Election Officer of the municipality or city where the concerned barangay belongs. Such SK member shall hold office for the unexpired portion of the term of the vacant seat. For this purpose, any citizen of the Philippines residing in the said barangay for at least six (6) months who attains the age of fifteen (15) years old but not more than thirty (30) years old at the time of the special election and who registers as member of the KK before the SK secretary shall be entitled to vote in the said special election. (c) All other vacancies in the office of the SK shall be filled in accordance with the immediately preceding provision. (d) Vacancies that are temporary in nature due to physical or legal reasons such as, but not limited to, leave of absence and travel abroad, shall be filled up in accordance with the following: (I) if vacancy is within a three-day period, the SK Chairperson shall designate an Officer-in-Charge (OIC) from among the SK members; and (2) if vacancy is more than a three-day period, the next SK member who obtained the highest number of votes in the election immediately preceding, shall assume the office of the chairperson on the fourth day. (e) In case of suspension of the SK chairperson, the successor, as determined in subsection (a) of this section, shall assume the position during the period of such suspension. " Be that as it may, the Sangguniang Kabataan Special Elections (SKSE) cannot be done as of the moment due to the Advisory issued by the Department dated 1 March 2019, temporarily suspending the conduct of the SKSEs pending the issuance of the pertinent Resolution by the Commission on Elections (COMELEC) En Banc. In view thereof, it is with much regret to inform you that the Department cannot give due course to the Resolution requesting the Secretary of the Interior and Local Government alone to issue guidelines providing immediate remedy in filling up vacant positions of Sangguniang Kabataan Officials. Meantime, please be rest assured that this Department will explore for a possible issuance of remedial guidelines to be jointly issued by the

National Youth Commission, the DILG, the COMELEC, the Department of Budget and Management, the CHED, the Department of Education and the COA, in line with Section 34 of RA No. 10742. We hope to have assisted you on the matter. Thank you. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: MARIV L .
